$comment: The pinned build of emdash's chat transcript UI that Waypoint renders agent sessions with (ROAD-59). An unmodified build of @emdash/chat-ui plus the @emdash/core / @emdash/shared type declarations its public types reference, at the same emdash commit as the engine (engine.lock.json). Fetched by hash into ./vendor/ (gitignored) by scripts/fetch-chat-ui.mjs; the sha256 is what makes it the pinned build and not whatever is at the URL.
name: emdash-chat-ui
builtWith: pnpm --filter @emdash/chat-ui build (packages/chat-ui, 2026-09-12) + the packages' own dist type declarations

peers.solid-js: 1.9.13 — the one dependency the build externalises; installed by Waypoint
peers.zod: 4.4.3 — types only; the vendored @emdash/core declarations are written against it
